name: The Self Tan Soufflé
one_liner: Self-tan mousse in a taupe pump bottle; dispensed onto an applicator and blended into the skin for an even, streak-free tan.
role: The self-tan product itself. A MOUSSE, pumped from the bottle onto an applicator (Buff & Glow Mitt velvet side, or a brush), then rubbed/blended into the skin until even. Never the prep tool; always the 'apply' step payload.
form_confirmed: MOUSSE (confirmed by Matt 2026-07-16). It is rubbed/blended into the skin and absorbs — never left as a thick stripe or dollop on the skin.
hero_action: A pump of golden-brown mousse dispensed onto the velvet side of the mitt (stills only), and the resulting even, streak-free golden glow on the skin.
correct_motions: Dispensed by pump onto the applicator — never squeezed, poured or scooped.
Blended into the skin via the applicator with long overlapping strokes until even (the applicator's motion rules govern).
never_show: Applying the mousse with bare hands (stains palms; applicator exists for this).
Mousse left sitting on the skin as a thick stripe, dollop or painted line — it is blended in until even.
The bottle being used as the applicator (rubbing the bottle on skin).
Pumping/dispensing as a VIDEO action — dispensing belongs in approved stills; in video the bottle is held or standing in-frame (label large and static), per the video envelope.
Relying on legible label text in motion — the label garbles; label close-ups are stills.
An orange, streaky, patchy or two-tone result.
